team.format: Each athlete does the whole EMOM in their own heat (a split team in CompHQ). Team score = the three lanes added; tiebreak = the best single athlete.

notes: Finished early? Rest until the next minute.
Capped: circle the last box reached; the grey number is this athlete’s total.
warnings: Minutes printed: the strongest Scaled athletes may reach minute 10 (12 + 12), so 11 minutes print.
Turn on “Best Athlete Breaks Ties” in the workout settings: CompHQ then takes the team’s best lane as its tiebreak.
